description: Work out how much fabric a reupholstery job needs, in metres and yards. Use this whenever someone asks how much fabric, cloth or material to buy for a chair, sofa, stool, headboard or cushion. Two ways to call it: give a piece name for a rule-of-thumb figure, or give a list of panels with their measurements for a proper cut-list estimate. Handles non-standard fabric widths and pattern repeats. Returns a buy-this-much figure rounded up to the half metre, because cloth is cut in practical lengths.

fabric_width_cm.description: Roll width. Default 137 cm, the usual UK upholstery width. American 54-inch cloth is the same thing.

panels.description: Optional. Measured panels for an accurate estimate. Overrides "piece" if given.

quantity.description: How many of this panel. Default 1.

pattern_repeat_allowance.description: Multiplier for matching a pattern. 1 = plain cloth (default). Trade allowances: 1.10 for a repeat up to 20 cm, 1.15 for 20-40 cm, 1.25 for 40-70 cm.

piece.description: Furniture type, e.g. "wing-back armchair", "3-seat sofa", "drop-in dining seat", "footstool". Options: drop-in dining seat, stuffover dining chair, carver dining armchair, bedroom slipper chair, nursing chair, tub chair, club armchair, wing-back armchair, recliner armchair, loveseat, 2-seat sofa, 3-seat sofa, 4-seat sofa, corner sofa, chaise longue, dressing-table stool, footstool, window seat cushion, large ottoman, headboard single, headboard double, headboard king, deep-buttoned headboard double

seam_allowance_cm.description: Turnings added to every edge of every panel in measured mode. Default 5 cm.

name: calculate_fabric
title: Calculate upholstery fabric quantity
